mal:area.name: SoftwareManagement
mal:area.comment:
The Software Management set of services contains services for on-board software management of a spacecraft. The following services are contained in the Software Management set: The Memory Management service is a low-level service intended to be used to load, dump and check memory addresses. The Software Image service is intended to manage Software Images and Software Patches by allowing the generation of new Software Images from a patch. The Package Management service allows the management of software packages on modern operating systems using the concept of packages. The Apps Launcher service allows the management of runnable applications in a system. The Heartbeat service publishes a periodic beat to the consumers that are listening.
This section details the Software Management services. The area and structures are defined in terms of the MO Message Abstraction Layer (MAL), so it is possible to deploy them over any supported protocol and message transport.

mal:service.name: PackageManagement
mal:service.comment: The Package Management service provides the ability to install, uninstall, upgrade, list, check packages. The service shall optionally support verification of packages, verification of digital signatures, upgrade software, manage dependencies. Packages can be organized in different categories in order to facilitate the management of software.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The Package Management service shall provide:
  1. the capability for listing, installing and uninstalling packages;
  2. the capability for upgrading packages;
  3. the capability for checking the integrity of a package.

mal:service.name: Heartbeat
mal:service.comment: The Heartbeat service provides the ability to periodically publish a heartbeat message. Additionally it is possible to get the period of the beat.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The Heartbeat service shall provide:
  1. the capability for periodic monitoring of the beat;
  2. the capability for retrieving the period of the beat.

mal:pubsubIP.name: beat
mal:pubsubIP.comment: The beat operation allows a provider to periodically send a heartbeat to the consumers.

mal:requestIP.name: getPeriod
mal:requestIP.comment: The getPeriod operation allows a consumer to get the period of the provider's heartbeat.

mal:field.name: period
mal:field.comment: The period of the heartbeat message.

mal:service.comment: The Command Executor service allows executing arbitrary system commands and monitoring their status.
mal:service.mal:documentation: The body of the Command COM object shall be of type CommandDetails.

mal:requestIP.name: runCommand
mal:requestIP.comment: The runCommand operation allows a consumer to spawn a new shell instance and execute an arbitrary command on the provider host.

mal:field.name: command
mal:field.comment: Details of the command to be run.

mal:field.name: commandInstId
mal:field.comment: The COM object instance identifier of the spawned command, as stored in the Archive.

com:objects.comment: The Command COM object used by the Command Executor service.

com:event.comment: This event is produced to allow monitoring of the command stdout output. It contains a buffer of an arbitrary size with a chunk of stdout output.
com:event.name: StandardOutput

com:event.comment: This event is produced to allow monitoring of the command stderr output. It contains a buffer of an arbitrary size with a chunk of stderr output.
com:event.name: StandardError

com:event.comment: This event is produced to indicate that the command has finished its execution. Contains an exit code.
com:event.name: ExecutionFinished

mal:service.name: AppsLauncher
mal:service.comment: The Apps Launcher service provides the ability to monitor the execution, run, stop, kill and list applications software on-board of a spacecraft. The apps can be organized in categories. The service is independent from any particular Operating System or platform.
mal:service.mal:documentation:
The Apps Launcher service shall provide:
  1. the capability for periodic monitoring of the applications output;
  2. the capability for running and killing applications;
  3. the capability for stopping applications;
  4. the capability for listing the ids for the available apps.
The body of the App COM object shall be of type AppDetails.
The App COM object source link should point to the package from where the app was installed.
The body of the StopApp COM event shall be the name of the app to be stopped.
The StopApp COM event related link shall point to the App COM object.
The StopApp COM event shall be generated by the stopApp operation.
The Stopping COM event source link shall point to the StopApp COM event that requested the application to stop, or to NULL if there was no request.
The Stopping COM event shall be generated by the application when it is going to stop its execution.
The Stopped COM event source link shall point to the StopApp COM event that requested the application to stop, or to NULL if there was no request.
The Stopped COM event shall be generated by the application when it has completely stopped its execution.
The body of the StartApp COM event shall be the name of the app to be started.
The StartApp COM event related link shall point to the App COM object.
The StartApp COM event shall be generated by the runApp operation.

mal:pubsubIP.name: monitorExecution
mal:pubsubIP.comment: The monitorExecution operation allows a consumer to subscribe for the application execution output stream.
mal:pubsubIP.mal:documentation: The timestamp of the NOTIFY message shall be the on-board time at which it is published.
The PUBLISH message shall include the ObjectKey of the source link of the update.
If no source link is needed, then the service provider shall set the ObjectKey to NULL.

mal:progressIP.comment: The stopApp operation allows a consumer to stop the execution of an application on the provider.
mal:progressIP.mal:documentation: The service provider shall send the UPDATE message after the app acknowledges the command to stop.

mal:requestIP.comment: The listApp operation allows a consumer to request the ids of the Apps objects and running status for an app name or for a certain app category.
mal:requestIP.mal:documentation: The service provider shall maintain the same order in the returned lists as the submitted appNames list unless the wildcard value was included in the request.
